jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind the cloud. CO+I is responsible for delivering Microsoft web portals, Live and Online Services around the world including infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and deliver trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the network that powers the world’s largest online services. 
 

The ITIM Sub-regional lead will oversee the operational activities for the Southern and Eastern Europe Subregion team. This includes the oversight of build contracting, design, execution, procurement and installation activities with safety at the forefront of mind. They will manage both internal and external stakeholders on the program alignment, while focusing on safety, cost, schedule and quality in all aspects of the DC execution lifecycle. 
 

The Southern and Eastern Europe Subregion team will oversee and take accountability for the team to produce and manage project plans as well as executing major milestones in the project lifecycle i.e. (Kick Off, Early Access, Beneficial Use, Corporate Network Live, BAS/EPMS Network, Zero Tolerance Network, Security CX Complete, RNI, Telecom Infrastructure Fit Out Complete, Office delivery, Lockdown, Colo Go Live) and for the financial approval and management function. 

This position will have responsibility of leading Integration scope of work for multiple campuses across Southern and Eastern Europe Subregion team. As part of the wider EMEA Datacentre Delivery team, the resource will help drive regional initiatives run through our global program team. 

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw:
Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of the Southern and Eastern Europe ITIM Sub-Regional Lead include, but are not limited to: 

Program & Portfolio Leadership: 

  • Lead the execution of all Southern and Eastern Europe datacentre build projects, ensuring predictable delivery of RNI and Integration scope milestones.
  • Drive strategic alignment with EMEA leadership on capacity planning, portfolio priorities, delivery risks, and long-range forecasting. 
  • Oversee simultaneous delivery of high MW, high complexity projects—including accelerated AI builds, Class A new builds and expansions.

Technical & Delivery Oversight: 

  • Provide technical direction across design, beneficial use, telco integration, network readiness, procurement sequencing, and construction execution. 
  • Ensure adherence to global processes, SOPs, Division 1 specifications, and standards. 
  • Resolve critical path dependencies across telecoms, security, fibre delivery, CorpNet/ZTN, and commissioning teams. 

Stakeholder & Partner Management: 

  • Serve as the primary interface with AEs, GCs, commissioning partners, and Microsoft cross functional teams (DCOPS, DCE/T, E2E, Safety, Cost, GSC). 
  • Lead escalations with external stakeholders related to design acceleration, Suppliers, PO cycles, schedule risk, and compliance. 
  • Ensure strong collaboration with SAP, E2E, DCD, and global engineering teams to maintain alignment on delivery models. 

People Leadership & Team Development: 

  • Lead, coach, and develop Integration & Technical Infrastructure Managers and vendor personnel across Central West Europe metros. 
  • Champion team culture, accountability, and performance—ensuring equitable workload distribution and proactive risk ownership. 
  • Oversee contractor/vendor performance, manage quality concerns, request replacements when needed, and uphold Microsoft standards onsite. 

Financial Governance & Budget Management: 

  • Oversee budget planning, RFP’s, and long-range forecasting for Southern and Eastern Europe projects. 
  • Ensure compliance with procurement processes, cost reviews, 3 quote requirements, and PO sequencing. 
  • Partner closely with Cost Management for financial controls, risk allocation, and cost optimization. 

Safety, Quality & Compliance: 

  • Champion Microsoft’s safety culture and ensure all projects adhere to EHS standards. 
  • Lead incident escalation, risk mitigation, and adherence to safe work practices across build and lease environments. 
  • Ensure quality processes are embedded, including commissioning readiness, documentation reviews, and turnover/acceptance compliance. 

Strategic Initiatives & Continuous Improvement: 

  • Drive adoption of programs such as Shift Left, AI acceleration models, fibre readiness frameworks, and process standardization. 
  • Identify systemic risks and process gaps and propose regionwide improvements. 
  • Represent Southern and Eastern Europe in regional/global forums, providing insights and shaping delivery strategy. 

Communication: 

  • Regularly reviews cost and KPI metrics, invoices, process/policy communications to partners. 
  • Coordinate meetings and activities of vendors, cost managers, and integration of lessons learned in support of the Data Center Integration & Construction Project Management Teams. 
  • Attend scheduled owner/architect/contractor (OAC) and other project meetings, and report, as necessary. 
  • Report Project Progress on scope, schedule, and budget in relation to the Lease Construction & Integration scope and packages as required for the Southern and Eastern Europe Sub-Region. 
  • Challenge and remove barriers by working with others around a shared need or customer benefit. 
  • Ability to maintain a broader perspective, identify and evaluate opportunities to enhance the business through cross-group collaboration. 
  • Incorporate diverse perspectives to thoroughly address complex business issues. 
  • Ability to align teams' expectations with organizational/ inter-departmental goals through clear prioritization. 

Accountability: 

  • Responsible for successfully meeting & exceeding all OKR’s for the Southern and Eastern Europe Sub-Region – around Predictability, Cost, Safety, Schedule & Quality. 
  • Work collaboratively with all partner teams (E2E, DCE, CIA, AHN, DCD, DCOps, Cost, GSC, LIP, DCI-NE, AI/GPU etc.) in support of the successful development of Data Center Projects in line with business requirements. 
  • Track lessons learned and apply to continuously improve processes and outcomes.  
  • Provide FTE & Vendor oversight and performance management, as required.  
  • Manage compliance with prior audit results and recommendations. 
  • Provide regular reports and updates to Regional CO+I LT on project progress. 
  • Identify & manage project risks helping with support & guidance on mitigation strategies.

jobs.titleRaw: Senior Cloud Solution Architecture - Data Security
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Step into a role where your ideas spark innovation and your impact is felt every day. As a Data Security Cloud Solution Architect in the Customer Success Unit, you help customers across Europe North strengthen trust in their data by designing and implementing secure cloud solutions. You work at the forefront of data security in an artificial intelligence–driven world, partnering with technical and business stakeholders to solve complex security challenges and unlock safe cloud adoption at scale.

In this role, you lead security adoption motions across seven subsidiaries, providing deep technical cybersecurity expertise on Microsoft cloud data security capabilities. You guide customers through the design and implementation of secure architectures, help them modernize and protect critical data estates, and ensure that security and compliance are embedded in every stage of their cloud journey. You drive reusable best practices and patterns that improve the scalable security posture of the Europe North area and serve as a role model for other security-focused architects and engineers.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw:
• Anticipate, identify, and translate complex customer or partner data security challenges into industry solutions that align with Microsoft cloud platform strategy, helping customers accelerate secure adoption and usage of Microsoft security and data protection capabilities.
  • Guide and mentor virtual teams and technical communities across the Customer Success Unit by role modeling technical readiness in security, resilience, and artificial intelligence–aligned scenarios, and leading upskilling activities that raise overall capability in data security architecture.
  • Proactively act as the voice of the customer, aggregating feedback and patterns across customers and industries, and presenting business cases and insights that influence product roadmaps, security features, and prioritization of fixes to improve customer outcomes.
  • Orchestrate and collaborate across Microsoft and customer teams to deliver secure, resilient, and cost‑optimized architectures, proactively identifying and mitigating technical and business risks to ensure successful deployment and long‑term adoption of data security solutions.
  • Lead strategic partner and customer opportunities in the data security space, leveraging market insights and industry trends to shape security offerings, drive consumption and usage growth, and position Microsoft solutions as trusted, innovative security platforms across Europe North.

jobs.titleRaw: Critical Environment Technician (CET) - Technik Infrastruktury Krytycznej
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Opis stanowiska

Jako Critical Environment Technician (CET) w zespole Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) będziesz wspierać utrzymanie infrastruktury krytycznej, która zapewnia nieprzerwane funkcjonowanie naszych centrów danych.
Do Twoich zadań może należeć m.in. podstawowe monitorowanie i kontrola infrastruktury, wykonywanie różnych rodzajów prac konserwacyjnych, udział w diagnozowaniu i usuwaniu usterek urządzeń, przestrzeganie oraz egzekwowanie wymogów dotyczących bezpieczeństwa i ochrony, a także opracowywanie metod wykonywania prac (MOP – Methods of Procedure) oraz standardowych procedur operacyjnych (SOP – Standard Operating Procedures).
Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) stanowi podstawę infrastruktury obsługującej nasze usługi chmurowe. Jako CO+I Critical Environment Technician będziesz odgrywać ważną rolę w zapewnianiu podstawowej infrastruktury i technologii niezbędnych do działania usług online Microsoft, takich jak Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive oraz platforma Microsoft Azure.
CO+I wspiera rozwój osobisty i zawodowy pracowników, oferując szkolenia oraz możliwości rozwoju, w tym programy rotacji zawodowej, szkolenia i wydarzenia związane z różnorodnością i inkluzywnością oraz możliwość zdobywania certyfikatów zawodowych.
Nasza infrastruktura obejmuje rozbudowaną globalną sieć ponad 200 centrów danych w 32 krajach oraz miliony serwerów. Jest ona zarządzana przez zespół ekspertów wspierających usługi dla ponad 1 miliarda klientów i 20 milionów firm w ponad 90 krajach na całym świecie.
 
English version

As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will help to maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our datacenters up and running. This could be anything from performing basic monitoring and inspection, performing various types of maintenance, participating in equipment troubleshooting, enforcing all safety and security requirements, and developing methods of operating procedures (MOPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw:
Zakres obowiązków

  • Wykonywanie przydzielonych podstawowych zadań, takich jak obchody obiektu, rejestrowanie obserwacji dotyczących budynku oraz wykonywanie pomiarów, przy różnym poziomie nadzoru.
  • Podstawowe monitorowanie i kontrolowanie urządzeń związanych z infrastrukturą krytyczną, takich jak systemy sterowania, ogrzewania, wentylacji i klimatyzacji (HVAC) oraz systemy mechaniczne, a także budynków i terenów zewnętrznych pod kątem niebezpiecznych lub nietypowych warunków.
  • Nauka bezpiecznej i profesjonalnej obsługi wszystkich systemów i urządzeń oraz poznawanie zagrożeń związanych z ich użytkowaniem.
  • Korzystanie z wewnętrznego komputerowego systemu zarządzania utrzymaniem ruchu (CMMS) w celu rejestrowania urządzeń oraz realizacji zleceń dotyczących prac konserwacyjnych.
  • Bezpieczne wspieranie monitorowania sytuacji awaryjnych i reagowania na różnego rodzaju nieprawidłowości, pod nadzorem i zgodnie z procedurami awaryjnymi (EOP – Emergency Operating Procedures).
  • Wykonywanie różnych rodzajów prac konserwacyjnych, w tym konserwacji planowej, predykcyjnej i naprawczej, zgodnie z przydzielonymi zadaniami, metodami wykonywania prac (MOP) oraz standardowymi procedurami operacyjnymi (SOP), w razie potrzeby pod nadzorem.
  • Dokumentowanie wykonanych zadań oraz problemów wykrytych podczas konserwacji i diagnozowania usterek, zapewnianie odpowiednich działań następczych oraz eskalowanie problemów w razie potrzeby.
  • Zapewnianie wymaganej asysty na terenie obiektu zewnętrznym wykonawcom, podwykonawcom, dostawcom oraz usługodawcom zgodnie z odpowiednimi procedurami i poziomem ryzyka.
  • Znajomość, przestrzeganie i egzekwowanie wymogów dotyczących bezpieczeństwa i ochrony, w tym ocen zagrożeń związanych z wykonywaną pracą (JHA – Job Hazard Assessments), zasad ochrony środowiska, bezpieczeństwa i higieny pracy (EH&S) oraz odpraw bezpieczeństwa (toolbox talks).
  • Przestrzeganie procesów i procedur biznesowych w celu zapewnienia bezpiecznego, wysokiej jakości i niezawodnego wykonywania pracy zgodnie z obowiązującymi wymogami prawa oraz standardami Microsoft.
  • Postępowanie zgodnie z kulturą i wartościami Microsoft.

English version

Responsibilities:

  • Perform assigned basic tasks (e.g., making rounds, recording building observations, taking measurements) with varying levels of supervision.
  • Under varying levels of supervision, you will perform basic monitoring and inspection of critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds for unsafe or abnormal conditions.
  • Learn how to operate all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and learn about all risks associated with these systems.
  • Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
  • Safely assist in providing emergency monitoring and response to various abnormal conditions with supervision following emergency operating procedures (EOPs).
  • Perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) as assigned following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) under supervision where needed.
  • Document tasks/issues found in maintenance and troubleshooting for follow up as needed and escalate as appropriate.
  • Provide necessary escorts for third-party contractors, sub-contractors, vendors, and service providers on site based on the appropriate severity-level procedures.
  • Understand, follow, and ensure safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance with applicable federal, state, local, and Microsoft requirements.
  • Embody our culture and values
jobs.minimumQualificationsRaw:
• Wymagane kwalifikacje:

    • Wykształcenie średnie lub równoważne.
    • Znajomość języka angielskiego umożliwiająca swobodną komunikację w środowisku pracy.
    • Technicy Critical Environment muszą posiadać odpowiednie świadectwo kwalifikacyjne uprawniające do wykonywania prac związanych z eksploatacją urządzeń, instalacji oraz sieci energetycznych, czyli polskie świadectwo kwalifikacyjne SEP, co najmniej typu „E” (Eksploatacja). SEP oznacza Stowarzyszenie Elektryków Polskich (Association of Polish Electrical Engineers). Uprawnienia SEP wydawane są na okres 5 lat, a ważne świadectwo należy przedstawić podczas procesu rekrutacyjnego. Wytyczne w tym zakresie określa Ustawa z dnia 10 kwietnia 1997 r. – Prawo energetyczne (Dz.U. z 2006 r. Nr 89, poz. 625 z późn. zm.) oraz Rozporządzenie Ministra Gospodarki, Pracy i Polityki Społecznej z dnia 28 kwietnia 2003 r. w sprawie szczegółowych zasad stwierdzania posiadania kwalifikacji przez osoby zajmujące się eksploatacją urządzeń, instalacji i sieci energetycznych (Dz.U. Nr 89, poz. 828).
    • Gotowość do pracy zmianowej, w tym poza standardowymi godzinami pracy, co może obejmować zmiany wieczorne, nocne, weekendy i/lub święta.

    Wymagania dotyczące weryfikacji bezpieczeństwa:

    Na tym stanowisku wymagane jest spełnienie wymogów Microsoft, klientów i/lub odpowiednich instytucji państwowych dotyczących weryfikacji bezpieczeństwa. Wymagania te obejmują między innymi następujące specjalistyczne kontrole bezpieczeństwa:
    • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: osoba zatrudniona na tym stanowisku musi pomyślnie przejść proces weryfikacji Microsoft Cloud przy zatrudnieniu lub przeniesieniu na stanowisko oraz ponownie co dwa lata.

    Preferowane kwalifikacje:

    Choć nie są one wymagane, dodatkowym atutem będą:
    • Wykształcenie średnie lub równoważne ORAZ udokumentowane doświadczenie w usługach technicznych (np. w środowiskach produkcyjnych/montażowych o wysokiej dostępności lub środowiskach infrastruktury krytycznej, takich jak centra danych, rafinerie ropy naftowej i gazu, szpitale lub zakłady farmaceutyczne).
    LUB
    • Wykształcenie techniczne, ukończenie szkoły technicznej/zawodowej, odpowiednie kwalifikacje zawodowe (np. wojskowe lub techniczne) lub wykształcenie wyższe o równoważnym profilu.
    LUB
    • Równoważne doświadczenie zawodowe.

English version

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • CE Technicians need to provide a qualification certificate to engage in the operation of equipment, installations, and networks working in an operational capacity (Polish SEP-certified electrician's license, at least type “E”. SEP stands for “Stowarzyszenie Elektryków Polskich / Association of Polish Electrical Engineers”). SEP qualifications are issued for 5 years and an active certificate need to be provided during the Recruiting process. Guidelines in this respect are set out in the Act of 10 April 1997. - Energy Law (Journal of Laws of 2006, No. 89, item 625, as amended) and the Regulation of the Minister of Economy, Labour and Social Policy of 28 April 2003 on the detailed rules for ascertaining qualifications of persons involved in the operation of equipment, installations and energy networks (Journal of Laws No. 89, item 828).
  • Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays

Background Check Requirements: 

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND demonstrated technical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical)
    • OR Associate's Degree or technical trade certification (e.g., military, trade school), or higher-equivalent education
    • OR equivalent experience.

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Shape the Future of AI. Transform Partners into Frontier Leaders. Scale Business Impact.

Join Microsoft's high-performing Cloud & AI Partner Architects team in DACH and play a pivotal role in accelerating AI innovation and business transformation across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland through our strategic partner ecosystem.

As a Senior Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI, you will combine deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, and strategic business acumen to help our most influential partners design, build, and scale innovative AI-powered solutions. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, guiding partners through complex architectural decisions, solution development, and the adoption of Microsoft's latest cloud, data, and AI technologies.

A key part of your mission is to accelerate the evolution of our partners into Frontier Partners-helping them move beyond traditional technology services and isolated AI experiments toward AI-first business models, intelligent agent-based solutions, differentiated intellectual property (IP), and scalable, repeatable offerings that deliver measurable customer outcomes.

You will work closely with partner executives, technical leaders, engineering teams, and Microsoft sales organizations to shape AI transformation strategies, lead architectural design sessions, accelerate production-ready solutions, and unlock new market opportunities. By combining technical leadership with a strong understanding of partner business models, you will help partners turn innovation into sustainable growth and scale successful solutions across customers and markets.

Leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Services, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, and GitHub, you will drive the development of scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready AI and data architectures.

We are looking for a senior technical leader who can connect technology with business impact-someone who challenges conventional thinking, influences strategic decisions, inspires technical teams, and helps shape the next generation of AI-powered partner businesses.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  • Drive Frontier AI Transformation: Act as a strategic technical advisor to senior partner stakeholders, helping partners evolve into Frontier Partners by adopting AI-first strategies, agentic AI solutions, and new business models. Connect technology innovation with measurable business outcomes, accelerating partner growth and customer transformation.
  • Accelerate Data & AI Business Growth: Proactively identify and shape opportunities to increase Azure Data & AI consumption, drive adoption of Microsoft Fabric and Foundry, and expand partner-led customer reach. Collaborate across Microsoft sales, engineering, and partner organizations to accelerate pipeline creation, solution adoption, and sustainable business impact at scale.
  • Influence Strategic Technology Decisions: Challenge conventional approaches, guide partners through complex architectural and business decisions, and translate emerging technology trends into actionable transformation strategies. Proactively address technical and business risks, including security, data governance, privacy, responsible AI, and operational resilience.

Partner Specialization

  • Build Frontier Partner Capabilities: Lead the technical transformation of strategic partners by developing their Data & AI practices, architectural capabilities, and technical readiness. Help partners establish differentiated AI offerings, agentic solutions, and scalable delivery models that enable them to compete and grow in the evolving AI market.
  • Accelerate Solution Innovation & Specialization: Guide partners in designing and delivering secure, scalable, production-ready Data & AI solutions, leveraging Microsoft Foundry, Fabric, Azure AI Services, and modern cloud architectures. Lead architectural design sessions, technical workshops, and strategic customer engagements while accelerating relevant Microsoft Solutions Partner designations and specializations, including Frontier AI.
  • Scale Repeatable Partner Solutions: Enable partners to move beyond individual projects and proofs of concept by developing differentiated IP, reusable architectures, industry solutions, and repeatable offerings. Collaborate with partner and Microsoft go-to-market teams to accelerate commercialization, customer adoption, and scalable revenue opportunities.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead with Technical Excellence: Serve as a senior technical authority and trusted advisor across Data & AI, combining deep architectural expertise with a broad understanding of cloud-native applications, security, and agentic AI. Influence complex solution architectures, challenge technical assumptions, and guide partners toward scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready implementations.
  • Shape Technical Strategy & Innovation: Leverage market insights, partner feedback, and emerging technology trends to influence technical priorities, solution investments, and partner transformation strategies. Contribute to Microsoft's technical communities by developing reference architectures, accelerators, best practices, and innovative solution patterns that can be scaled across the partner ecosystem.
  • Inspire, Mentor & Scale Expertise: Act as a technical thought leader and mentor, driving knowledge sharing, coaching, and technical readiness across Microsoft and partner teams. Lead cross-functional initiatives, engage with senior technical stakeholders, and represent Microsoft's technology vision through strategic partner engagements, industry events, technical communities, and thought leadership.
jobs.minimumQualificationsRaw:
Required Qualifications

  • Extensive Technical Experience: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field and multiple years of experience in cloud technologies, Data & AI solutions, software development, solution architecture, technical consulting, or technical pre-sales or equivalent experience.
  • Senior Technical Leadership: Proven experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales, with the ability to lead complex technical engagements, influence senior stakeholders, and translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Data & AI Expertise: Strong technical knowledge of modern data platforms, cloud-native architectures, AI services, and enterprise AI solution development, including experience designing and implementing scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.
  • Language Skills: Professional English proficiency and fluency in German, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep Microsoft Data & AI Expertise: Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and related Azure data and application services. Strong understanding of modern data architectures, analytics, AI platforms, and cloud-native solution development.
  • Agentic AI & Emerging Technologies: Experience designing and implementing generative AI and agentic AI solutions, including AI agents, orchestration frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise AI integration, and responsible AI principles. Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into production-ready business solutions.
  • Enterprise Architecture & Solution Development: Proven experience leading complex architectural design sessions, developing Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and transitioning innovative solutions into secure, scalable production environments.
  • Partner Transformation & Business Acumen: Experience working with technology partners, system integrators, or enterprise customers to develop technical capabilities, solution practices, differentiated IP, and repeatable offerings. Strong understanding of how technology innovation translates into business value, customer adoption, and sustainable growth.
  • Strategic Influence & Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior technical and business stakeholders, challenge existing approaches, and drive technical decisions across complex organizations. Experience mentoring technical teams, leading cross-functional initiatives, and shaping technical strategies.
  • Competitive Landscape & Industry Trends: Strong understanding of the evolving Data & AI ecosystem, including hyperscaler platforms, emerging AI technologies, open-source frameworks, and competitive offerings from AWS, Google Cloud, and other AI platform providers.
  • Customer & Partner Engagement: 10+ years of experience in customer-facing or partner-facing technical roles, with a track record of driving complex technical projects, accelerating technology adoption, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Technical Certifications: Relevant advanced certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700), or equivalent certifications from AWS, Google Cloud, or other recognized technology providers.
